verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Recruitee manages job openings and publishes offers (docs-3, docs-34), and offers a Careers Site API to display jobs (docs-4) plus job-board feeds (docs-7, docs-39), implying a hosted job-offer listing exists, but there is no explicit documentation of a turnkey branded careers page on a custom domain that requires zero engineering — the only 'custom site' path described explicitly requires building against the API. Missing for 10: explicit mention of a no-code hosted careers page builder, custom-domain support, and branding/theming controls.
